title: 날씨와 자연: 장마, 태풍, 지진이 오면?
objective: By the end, you can name common seasonal weather and natural disasters in Korean, such as 장마, 태풍 and 지진. You can also use 피해 and 대피하다 in short sentences about them.
summary: Learn ten intermediate words for seasonal weather and natural disasters in Korea and how they are used in everyday sentences.

task.title: Use weather and disaster words
task.line: Read each sentence or situation, then choose, write or judge the word that fits.

words.meaning: the summer rainy season (weeks of steady rain)
words.example: 장마가 시작돼서 일주일 내내 비가 와요.
words.exampleMeaning: The rainy season has started, so it rains all week.

words.example: 태풍 때문에 제주도 가는 비행기가 취소됐어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My flight to Jeju was cancelled because of the typhoon.

words.example: 비가 너무 많이 와서 마을에 홍수가 났어요.
words.exampleMeaning: It rained so much that the village flooded.

words.meaning: drought, a long time with no rain
words.exampleMeaning: The drought went on so long that the river dropped a lot.
There was a small earthquake last night. Did you feel it?

words.meaning: yellow dust (sand blown in, mostly in spring)
words.example: 황사가 심한 날에는 마스크를 꼭 쓰세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Be sure to wear a mask on days with heavy yellow dust.

words.meaning: the temperature gap between morning/night and daytime
words.example: 요즘 일교차가 커서 아침에는 겉옷이 필요해요.
words.exampleMeaning: These days the gap between day and night temperatures is big, so you need a jacket in the morning.

words.meaning: the time when one season changes to the next
words.exampleMeaning: It's easy to catch a cold when the seasons change.

words.meaning: damage or harm from a disaster (피해를 입다: to suffer damage)
words.exampleMeaning: Many houses were damaged in the wildfire.

words.meaning: to evacuate, to move to a safe place
words.example: 지진이 나면 건물 밖 넓은 곳으로 대피하세요.
words.exampleMeaning: If there is an earthquake, evacuate to an open area outside the building.

exercises: Choose the right word for each situation: ① 몇 달 동안 비가 안 와서 땅이 갈라졌어요. (홍수 / 가뭄) ② 갑자기 땅이 흔들려서 책상 밑에 들어갔어요. (지진 / 태풍) ③ 하늘이 노랗고 공기에 모래 먼지가 많아요. (황사 / 장마) ④ 비가 사흘 동안 쏟아져서 마을 길이 물에 잠겼어요. (홍수 / 가뭄)
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 낮에는 25도인데 밤에는 10도예요. ____가 정말 크네요.
Fill in the blank with the past tense of 대피하다 (polite form): 강물이 넘쳐서 주민들이 근처 체육관으로 ____.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 비가 계속 와서 과일 농장의 ____가 컸어요.
Read and answer Yes or No: ① 일교차가 크면 아침과 낮의 기온이 많이 달라요. ② 장마 때는 비가 거의 안 와요. ③ 홍수가 나면 물이 부족해요. ④ 황사가 심한 날에는 창문을 닫는 게 좋아요.
Write the word in Korean: ① 봄에서 여름으로, 여름에서 가을로 계절이 바뀌는 때 ② 여름이나 가을에 강한 바람과 큰비를 몰고 오는 것
answers: ① 가뭄 ② 지진 ③ 황사 ④ 홍수
① Yes ② No ③ No ④ Yes
